psychological: We are concerned about the psychological effect the experience may have on the girls.
Many psychological theories refer to problematic parent-child relationships.
psychology: The study of the mind and behaviour.
Research in sports psychology demonstrates the value of setting difficult goals.
psychiatrist: A psychiatrist is a doctor who helps people whose minds are sick.
She went to a psychiatrist to try to learn to think about her life in a more normal way.
psycho: Short for psychotic; not able to tell what is real or not.
He is totally psycho and thinks he is Jesus.
A psycho is a person who acts in a strange and often dangerous way.
That psycho has been stalking me all year. I'm afraid he might do something to me any time.
psychotic: Having psychosis. If you are psychotic you do not know what is real and what is imaginary because of mental illness.
psychosis: Psychosis is mental illness that causes imaginary things to seem real. These imaginary things could be delusions (false ideas) or hallucinations (things you might see or hear that are not real).
His psychosis led him think I had stolen his stomach and hidden it.
psychoanalysis: Psychoanalysis is a method of psychotherapy and science of the mind based on finding a connection among patients' dreams and thoughts, speaking whatever came to the patients' mind.
Charles Socarides was an American psychoanalyst and psychiatrist who treated people for sexual issues by performing psychoanalysis.
psychotherapy: Psychotherapy is a method of psychological help where a patient tries to solve his mental problems by talking about them with a psychotherapist.
John used psychotherapy to help him with his depression.
psychiatry: Psychiatry is a type of science. It studies mental illnesses, like depression and anxiety.
By studying psychiatry, scientists have found new medicines that help people with depression.
Psychiatry is a special type of medicine (health care) that treats people with mental illnesses.
The doctor at the hospital decided to call the department of psychiatry for her patient. She thought psychiatry could help him with his depression.
psephology: Psephology is the study of elections.
pseudonym: A pseudonym is a fake name.
Samuel Clemens' pseudonym was Mark Twain.
psychologist: A psychologist is an expert in the field of psychology.
psychotherapist: A psychotherapist is a doctor who specializes in psychotherapy.
Madison was a psychotherapist, and she helped people with mental illnesses.
psychedelic: If something is psychedelic, it is related to hallucinations induced by drugs.
If a design is psychedelic, it has bright colours and abstract shapes.
psychiatric: If something is psychiatric, it is related to psychiatry.
psychic: A psychic is someone who appears to have extra-sensory abilities such as clairvoyance, and telepathy.
If something is psychic, it is related to or have the abilities of a psychic.
pseudo-acronym: A pseudo-acronym is a word that looks like an acronym or any abbreviation, but doesn't mean something.
